faqs.question: How do affiliate tracking links work?
faqs.answer: Each product tracking link contains a unique affiliate code attributed to your account. When a prospect clicks the link and registers for a service, our attribution system credits the conversion and commission to your account automatically.

faqs.question: When and how are commissions paid?
faqs.answer: Commissions are calculated monthly and processed on the 15th of each following month for all active conversions exceeding the payout threshold.

faqs.question: What if a product action is disabled?
faqs.answer: Products marked as under maintenance or in development have Details and Tracking Links temporarily disabled until the software release is complete.

faqs.question: How do I invite my team?
faqs.answer: Partners and resellers can invite teammates from Team Access. Assign a role, send the invitation email, and the member activates access after accepting.

faqs.question: Where can I find marketing assets?
faqs.answer: Open the Affiliate Portal and use Marketing Assets Library to download approved banners, one-pagers, and social creatives for your campaigns.
